summary: First-iteration full-stack testing for Timberline Custom Homes website. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass (health, root, contact 503 when RESEND_API_KEY empty, all 5 required-field 422 cases, invalid-email 422). Frontend: all 4 pages load with header+footer, Home hero/services(12)/gallery(6)/experience(30)/mission CTA verified, sticky header turns solid #01261d after scroll, mobile hamburger opens overlay, About shows 4 stats / 4 value cards / 8 office + 4 field team members each with name, title and 'TEAM MEMBER SINCE <year>', Process shows numbered steps 01-06, Contact form floating labels work, both conditional 'Other' inputs (hear_about, project_type) appear, submit surfaces error toast 'Email service not configured. Please add RESEND_API_KEY to backend .env.' as expected (key intentionally empty). No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: In server.py the module-level `logger` is referenced inside submit_contact (line 130) but defined AFTER app/router include (line 170). Works at runtime since module load completes before requests, but ordering is fragile — move logging.basicConfig + logger setup to top of file.

action_items: Optional: relocate `logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)` and basicConfig to the top of /app/backend/server.py (before any route definitions) for safer initialization order.

When user provides RESEND_API_KEY, re-run a happy-path POST /api/contact to confirm email actually sends and frontend success state ('Send Another Inquiry' button via data-testid=send-another-button) is reached.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py logger defined after use (functional but fragile ordering)
Pages and components stay under 700 lines; no DRY violations spotted in pages reviewed.

All interactive elements have data-testid (input-first-name, input-last-name, input-email, select-budget, select-project-type, select-hear-about, input-project-type-other, input-hear-other, contact-submit-button, contact-error, contact-form, nav-link-*, mobile-menu-toggle, hero-cta-button, mission-cta-button, gallery-tile-{idx}, service-card-*, office-member-*, field-member-*, etc.)
Note: request mentions testid 'contact-submit' but actual is 'contact-submit-button' — pick one and document; both work, just naming consistency.
test_credentials: None required (no auth in this app).
context_for_next_testing_agent: App is multi-page marketing site, no auth, no DB writes. RESEND_API_KEY is intentionally empty in /app/backend/.env; POST /api/contact returns 503 with detail 'Email service not configured. Please add RESEND_API_KEY to backend .env.' Once user supplies key, retest by POSTing a valid payload and asserting 200 + email_id, then UI happy-path showing data-testid=contact-success and send-another-button. Contact form testids are input-first-name/last-name/email/phone, select-budget/contractors/hear-about/project-type, input-location/notes/hear-other/project-type-other, contact-submit-button, contact-error. About-page team prefixes are office-member-* and field-member-* (not field-team).
